metaTitle: Custom Screen Print Fleece | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print fleece for your team or event. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Screen printing on fleece delivers bold, durable logos that stand up to repeated wear and washing. Whether you need branded hoodies for a company outing or uniform jackets for a safety crew, screen print keeps your design crisp on cotton-poly blends and performance fleece. Choose from pullovers, zip-ups, or quarter-zip styles in your team colors. We recommend screen print for solid-color garments where high-contrast ink makes your message pop.
